E2.entry: next TWSE session open when observable
E2.exit: H20 close after 20 completed TWSE trading intervals following entry
E2.meaning: Existing aggregate paper assumption; not a calibrated broker cost model. Do not add components on top without a separately approved specification.

component_specification.needed: Broker schedule, discount and minimum fee; buy/sell and rounding.
Official effective-dated rate, security type, side and day-trading eligibility.
Timestamped executable bid/ask; daily OHLC is insufficient.
Order type, market impact, stressed calibration and effective dates.
Causal executable volume, participation ceiling and partial-fill rules.
Effective-dated exchange lot/tick tables, odd-lot policy and price rounding.
Submission/acknowledgment/queue/fill timestamps, no-fill/partial-fill and suspension/limit rules.
Research notional, allocation, cash, concentration and rounding; no real capital authority.

split: chronological fixed development/validation with prospective custody
pre-registered expanding walk-forward with prospective custody
horizon: pre-registered economic horizon with a separately approved execution design

approval_evidence_needed: Freeze actual coverage, vintages and outcome availability before setting boundaries.
Disclose all prior inspection; exposed dates cannot become pristine holdout.
Purge overlapping outcome intervals; embargo must account for horizon, publication lag and overlap.
Freeze minimum observations/trades, trial budget including failed variants and family-level multiple-testing correction.
Freeze risk/cost/turnover acceptance gates before outcome inspection; no threshold rescue.

immutability.record_hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false; exclude record_sha256 only
immutability.append_rule: Existing records must be an exact prefix; validate previous_sha256 chain, unique experiment IDs and earlier parent IDs.
immutability.anchor: An independently retained trusted head and record count must anchor each append; a self-contained hash chain cannot detect complete rewriting or truncation.
immutability.deployment: Future approved custody service must use atomic conditional append, single-writer serialization, WORM/versioned storage, independent checkpoints and access audit. No deployed storage is claimed here.
immutability.failed_experiments: Retain FAILED/REJECTED/ABORTED, metrics unavailable as null, and reason; never delete a failed trial.

custody_rules: UNALLOCATED -> SEALED -> OPENED -> CONSUMED; no reverse transition or second open.
SEALED requires independent custodian, artifact commitment, explicit human authorization and predeclared access policy.
Opening requires authorized identity, one-time token, immutable audit event and conditional state update before data release.
OPENED is already exposed; failure or interrupted evaluation does not restore pristine state.
Do not allocate, populate or open a holdout in Phase 1; local validation is not access authorization.

rules: Capture full eligible population and rejection/no-selection/no-fill events prospectively before outcomes.
Null publication/first-seen/revision fields must stay unknown; generated time is not a substitute.
Do not recompute historical candidate lists; no mixed engine ranking; actual user trades are not model evidence.
